This issue might be a duplicate of an existing issue. Please check:
- #15150: Same error — `opencode run --command` fails with `undefined is not an object (evaluating 'command3.agent')`, reproduced in an isolated config, same symptom across multiple versions.

This issue might be a duplicate of an existing issue. Please check:
- #17982: Describes the same root cause — the prompt loop continues to step N+1 after `finish=stop`, when it should terminate. That issue observed the bug as a prefill error on claude-opus-4-6, but the underlying mechanism (loop not gating continuation on finish reason) is the same as what you're reporting here.
Issue is not closed. PR is not yet merged. https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/7756#issuecomment-4042978112

Adding a second independent repro from a Linux/WSL2 environment.

What this adds beyond the original report:
- reproduced again in isolated config, with no extra plugins in the repro path
- reproduced across a wider local version range (`1.2.27` down to `1.2.10`)
- reproduced across multiple slash-command inputs, not just a single command shape
- same failure signature: `undefined is not an object (evaluating 'command3.agent')`

This strengthens the case that the bug belongs to OpenCode core command dispatch rather than command content.

Adding another minimal repro that appears to hit the same underlying loop/termination bug from a different angle.

Observed behavior in a control sample:
- parent session performs the main tool-call turn (`finish="tool-calls"`)
- then OpenCode generates one more assistant turn before exiting
- exported session shows that extra final turn as `finish="stop"` with empty text

From this repro angle, the continuation bug manifests as an unnecessary empty stop-turn after tool completion, rather than as a visible prompt/prefill error.

Evidence from the local investigation:
- control run log showed the parent session still advancing another prompt step before exit
- parent session export reduced to:
  - `user`
  - `assistant` with `finish="tool-calls"`
  - `assistant` with `finish="stop"` and empty text
Bot suggestion is correct. This is a duplicate of #15150. I have copied the additional evidence there and am closing this duplicate.

## Update - Issue Resolved

This issue has been resolved after reinstalling OpenCode.

**Resolution:** I uninstalled and reinstalled OpenCode using npm on Windows. After the fresh installation, the Kimi K2.5 model works correctly with the OpenCode Go provider using the same API key.

**Previous Version:** 1.2.26
**Current Version:** 1.3.2

It appears the installation may have been corrupted. A clean reinstall resolved the issue.
